quality_note: CEPEA tipo 6 is a domestic São Paulo price for natural (dry-processed) coffee: not semi-washed, not FOB Santos, not an exchange grade. Semi-washed certs on ICE need a quality premium and freight/fobbing on top. Like the ICO series, only the change in each gap against its own history means anything; the level is a quality/location difference.
